product.name: Dinosaur Adventure Blind-Box Countdown Calendar
product.category: 24-day Christmas countdown calendar with collectible dinosaur figures
product.core_function: Reveals one dinosaur surprise from a numbered door each day during a 24-day countdown.
product.primary_benefit: Turns the Christmas countdown into a repeatable daily dinosaur discovery ritual.
secondary_benefits: Creates 24 separate reveal moments instead of one gift-opening moment.
The figures can remain available for collecting, display, and play after the countdown.
The product page states that the figures can be used as dinosaur-themed Christmas ornaments.
